meta.title: Public Chamber
meta.slogan: For the people, by the people.
meta.disclaimer: Demo chamber. Live chat and call-in are simulated in this prototype. Under Maple rules, real sessions would stream with identity-verified citizens.

session.title: Public discussion: three-child dual-parent zero income tax

points: Three kids while married or common-law is rare and hard; tax code should not punish it.
Dual-parent zero is clearer than opaque credit mazes.
Pair with waste cuts so the math holds.
Score the hole against the personal income tax base before permanent law.
Need annual public cost and uptake scoreboard.
Childless workers ask who pays the residual.
Smooth path at one and two kids so the three-kid cliff is not gamed.
Provincial match matters for real take-home.
Citizens want this discussion always public, not lobby-only.
AI summary is useful if prompts and method stay visible.
Call-in queue must be fair and identity-checked.

ai_summary.udl_note: AI summary is input to Universal Decision Logic, not a vote count. Steelman and fiscal math still decide. Named humans still sign.

messages.text: I have three kids and both of us work. Zero tax for both parents would change our entire decade.
Support if the waste ledger actually funds it. No fairy-dust deficits.
The bill pairs dual-parent zero at three kids with published Trace savings path. Year-five review is mandatory.
I'm single, no kids. Fine with this if childless workers still see lower waste and open books. Don't hide the cost.
Make provincial match part of the decision package or the federal zero is half a promise.
Cluster update: support cluster leads on nation-building; fiscal caution second. Full steelman queued for Decision Package.
For the people, by the people means I can say this in public while you debate, not after the vote.
We will not pass without the UDL foreign-interest and data-grade blocks filled. No closed-door rewrite.
